texts.preamble: Sri Anirudda Negalur vs Sri. Gururaj Ramachandra Basur on 30 September, 2020 Author: Suraj Govindaraj Bench: Suraj Govindaraj Crl.P.No.101110/2020 :1: In The High Court Of Karnataka Dharwad Bench Dated This The 30Th Day Of September, 2020 Before The Hon'Ble Mr.Justice Suraj Govindaraj Criminal Petition No. 101110/2020 Between: Sri Anirudda Negalur Age:55 Years, Customer Coordinator Manager: Satishgouda M/S. Reliance Retail Limited, Reliance Fresh (Super Market) Court Circle, Dharwad ... Petitioner (By Sri. Gangadhar S. Hosakeri, Advocate) And: Sri. Gururaj Ramachandra Basur Age:66 Years, The Food Inspector, Hubli-Dharwad Municipal Corporation Dharwad-580001 ... Respondent (By Sri. G I Gachchinamath, Advocate) --- This Criminal Petition Is Filed U/S 482 Of Cr.P.C., Praying To Quash The Criminal Proceedings In Cc No.87/2011 On The File Of The I Addl. Senior Civil Judge And Cjm, Dharwad Which Came To Be Transferred And Renumbered As C.C. No.2665/2015 On The File Of The Ii Addl. Civil Judge & Jmfc -Ii, Dharwad For The Offence Sri Anirudda Negalur vs Sri. Gururaj Ramachandra Basur on 30 September, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/2527436/ 1 Punishable U/Sec.7(1) R/W SEC.16(i)(A) Of Prevention Of Food Adulteration Act, 1954, As Against The Petitioner Herein, Who Is Arrayed As Accused No.1. Crl.P.No.101110/2020 :2: This Petition Coming On For Admission This Day, The Court Made The Following: Order
texts.facts: The Public Analyst had provided a report on 15.12.2010 that the sample received by him was adulterated. 2.4 It is on this basis that the complaint came to be filed before the I Addl. for the aforesaid offences. 2.5 Subsequent thereto, on the appearance of the petitioner, the petitioner had filed an application under Section 205 of the Cr.P.C. for a direction by the Court to the respondent to forward a second sample for analysis by the Public Analyst in terms of Section 13(2) of the Act, which is reproduced hereunder for easy reference: "Section 13(2) Report of public analyst.-- (1) xxxxxxxxxxxx (2) On receipt of the report of the result of the analysis under sub-section (1) to the effect that the article of food is adulterated, the Local (Health) Authority shall, after the institution of prosecution against the persons from whom Sri Anirudda Negalur vs Sri. Gururaj Ramachandra Basur on 30 September, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/2527436/ 2 the sample of the article of food was taken and the person, if any, whose name, address and other particulars have been disclosed under section 14A, forward, in such manner as may be prescribed, a copy of the report of the result of the analysis to such person or persons, as the case may be, informing such person or persons that if it is so desired, either or both of them may make an application to the court within a period of ten days from the date of receipt of the copy of the report to get the sample of the article of food kept by the Local (Health) Authority analysed by the Central Food Laboratory." 2.6 Though the said application has been filed on 27.04.2011, till date the second sample has not been made available or forwarded to the Public Analyst by the respondent.
texts.arguments: 2.7 It is in view thereof that the petitioner is before this Court seeking for quashing of the entire proceedings contending that the petitioner has been unnecessarily harassed in the matter for the last 9 years and the criminal prosecution is going on without the respondent forwarding the second sample. 3. On issuance of notice, Sri. Gurudev I. Gachchinamath, learned counsel has entered appearance for the respondent and on enquiry as regards the existence or otherwise of the second sample, he submits that the second sample is not available with the respondent. He further submits that the adulterated product in the present matter is Amul pasteurized butter, which is a perishable product and at present not available.
texts.petitioner_arguments: 2.7 It is in view thereof that the petitioner is before this Court seeking for quashing of the entire proceedings contending that the petitioner has been unnecessarily harassed in the matter for the last 9 years and the criminal prosecution is going on without the respondent forwarding the second sample. He further submits that the adulterated product in the present matter is Amul pasteurized butter, which is a perishable product and at present not available.
texts.respondent_arguments: 3. On issuance of notice, Sri. Gurudev I. Gachchinamath, learned counsel has entered appearance for the respondent and on enquiry as regards the existence or otherwise of the second sample, he submits that the second sample is not available with the respondent.
